title: Stakeholder (catalogue instance schema)
description: Catalogue-instance projection of the metamodel Stakeholder entity (dea-metamodel v1.0.0 schemas/entities/stakeholder.json), aligned by CR-CATALOG-STRUCT-12. The normative field set is defined by the metamodel schema; this file mirrors it and narrows only the record id to this repo's org-wide namespace form (check_id_system.py IDM-001: stakeholders:stakeholder-<slug>-<hash6>) and to closed-world properties. Do not widen a normative enum here to accept a value the metamodel does not define: fix the record instead. A catalogue that diverges from the metamodel is a second source of truth.

id.description: OpenDEAM id, narrowed to this repo's org-wide namespace form (IDM-001; hash6 over the 31-symbol entropy alphabet).

lifecycle_status.description: CR-3R: lifecycle state from metamodel/vocabularies/lifecycle.yaml. Canonical records carry it (CST-004).

external_references.description: CR-3P: identifiers in external systems. Never a substitute for the OpenDEA id (E004).

stakeholder_type.description: The relationship class the stakeholder holds with the enterprise. Open set in the metamodel — new types are added there first, never widened locally.

relationships.description: Typed relationship instances asserted by this record (metamodel relationship-instance contract; vendored locally as relationship-instance.schema.json).

metadata.description: Free-form provenance/governance metadata (metamodel entity.json metadata, narrowed to object shape).
